pack.title: Holiday pressure
pack.description: Hold a hosting boundary after others make assumptions.

scenarios.setting: Your family expects you to host despite your already declining.
scenarios.jab: But everyone already assumes Christmas is at yours.
scenarios.goal: Hold a hosting boundary after others make assumptions.

replies.line: I won't be hosting. Please tell everyone so they can make other plans.
replies.why: It corrects the assumption and gives a practical next step.
replies.delivery: Pause, then say “I won't be hosting” at a steady, conversational volume. Keep the alternative discussion separate from your own availability.

replies.why: It states the decision without allowing the assumption to become an obligation.
replies.delivery: Stress “this year” once; keep the alternative discussion separate from your own availability.

replies.line: I understand people expected it; I can't host this year, so we need another plan.
replies.why: It acknowledges disappointment while keeping the decision clear.
replies.delivery: Stress “this year” once; keep the alternative discussion separate from your own availability.

replies.line: My house didn't approve that calendar invitation.
replies.why: Humor names the missing agreement without blaming individual relatives.
replies.delivery: Keep “My house didn't approve that calendar invitation” light; let the joke stand without repeating it. Keep the alternative discussion separate from your own availability.

followUp.jab: Where are we supposed to go then?
followUp.line: Let's discuss alternatives; my house isn't an option this year.
followUp.why: It offers problem-solving without reopening your boundary.
followUp.delivery: Stress “this year” once; keep the alternative discussion separate from your own availability.
